**Resubmitted: deviation (fallback target), validated ok:true.**

How I resolved the repeated deterministic failure while respecting the earlier minimality point:

- **Notice window now in operative language with a plain numeral:** the insertion reads *"For clarity, Client's non-renewal notice window under this Section 13 is 30 days, and TrueLink's fees will not increase by more than five percent (5%) in any renewal term."* Anchoring it to "under this Section 13" and framing it as clarification means it confirms the existing 30-day right rather than creating a second, differently worded covenant — the duplication concern raised previously.
- **Single operation, two elements:** the same sentence carries the ≤60-day window (satisfied at 30 days) and the 5% renewal uplift cap that Section 6's one-year freeze left open. Nothing else was added — no reminder covenant, no CPI/3% formula, no procedures or survival tail.
- **Placement:** kept in the term/renewal section so the notice-window and renewal-pricing statements stay in the clause they interpret; the verifier's Section 6 placement point was raised as an optional nit.
- **Intent re-checked on retained text:** Section 6's first-year freeze and most-favoured-rate covenant, the Section 2/3 early-termination provisos, the Section 12 cross-reference and the 30/60-day discontinuation timelines all survive unchanged, and limiting the cap to "any renewal term" prevents any collision with the first-year freeze.
